title: API client + shared types
description: Create api/client.ts (fetch wrapper with auth headers, error handling, base URL from env) and api/types.ts (Job, Workflow, WorkflowRun, PolicyBundle, Worker, Pack, AuditEntry, DLQEntry, etc.), response envelope types.
definitionOfDone: Auth token injected from Zustand auth store
Error handling: throws typed ApiError with status, message
api/types.ts exports all domain types: Job, Workflow, WorkflowRun, PolicyBundle, PolicyRule, Worker, Pack, AuditEntry, DLQEntry, Approval, Schema, User, ApiKey
Response envelope type: { data: T, meta?: { total, page } }

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/api/client.ts: Thin fetch wrapper with get<T>, post<T>, put<T>, patch<T>, del<T> methods. Reads auth token from state/config store (apiKey). Sends headers: Authorization (Bearer token or X-API-Key), X-Tenant-ID, Content-Type: application/json, X-Request-Id (uuid). Base URL from import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || '/api/v1'. Error handling: throws ApiError class with status, message, and response body. Handles 401 by clearing auth state and redirecting to /login. Handles 403, 429 (rate limit) with meaningful messages. No credentials/cookies sent (stateless API key auth).

Create dashboard/src/api/types.ts with all domain types. Must be strict TypeScript (no 'any'). Types: Job (id, type, topic, status: JobStatus, safetyDecision, pool, capabilities, riskTags, metadata, contextPtr, resultPtr, workflowRunId, createdAt, updatedAt, duration), JobStatus enum/union, SafetyDecision (type: allow|deny|require_approval|throttle, reason, matchedRule, evalTimeMs, evalPath), Workflow (id, name, steps, timeout, metadata, triggerType, lastRunAt, successRate), WorkflowRun (id, workflowId, status: RunStatus, steps, startedAt, completedAt, duration), WorkflowStep, PolicyBundle (id, name, rules, version, enabled, publishedAt, healthStatus), PolicyRule (id, matchCriteria, decisionType, reason, hitCount24h, lastTriggered, priority, logic), Worker (id, name, pool, capabilities, status, activeJobs, capacity, lastHeartbeat, uptime, version, address), Pack (id, name, version, status, capabilities, config, poolAssignment, manifest), AuditEntry (id, timestamp, eventType, actor, resourceType, resourceId, action, message, payload), DLQEntry (id, jobId, error, retryCount, maxRetries, originalTopic, failedAt, retryAttempts), Approval (id, jobId, status, requestedAt, resolvedAt, actor, reason, comment, policyRule, jobContext), Schema (id, name, version, fields, createdAt, updatedAt), User (id, username, email, displayName, roles, tenant, createdAt, lastLogin), ApiKey (id, name, prefix, scopes, createdAt, lastUsed, usageCount, expiresAt), AuthConfig (password_enabled, saml_enabled, default_tenant, oauth_enabled). Response envelope: ApiResponse<T> = { data: T, meta?: { total: number, page: number, perPage: number } }. Pagination type: PaginationParams = { page?: number, perPage?: number, sort?: string }.

Update dashboard/src/lib/api.ts bridge to import from api/client.ts instead of reimplementing fetch. The bridge file should re-export api object that AppShell needs (getSession, logout, listApprovals, listDLQPage) but now delegate to the proper client.
implementationPlan.note: Replaced inline fetch logic with imports from api/client.ts. Uses domain types from api/types.ts.
